H0001.text: IF density is produced by exemplar-prototype cosine matching over frozen DINOv2 tokens IN FSC147, THEN val MAE < 30 within 10 epochs, BECAUSE pretrained category-agnostic embeddings already separate instances so the head only learns calibration. DISPROVED IF val MAE >= 30 @ 10 epochs.

log.reasoning: N0002: frozen DINOv2-S reg4 single-prototype cosine->decoder gave val MAE 42.05 @10ep (best), 12 points above 30 threshold; trend 48.5->42.05 but still far; RMSE 122 indicates tail errors

H0002.text: IF a learnable temperature tau on the cosine map is added IN the same setting, THEN MAE drops >=5% vs fixed raw cosine, BECAUSE sharpness control lets the decoder trade localization precision against noise. DISPROVED IF delta MAE in (-5%, +5%).

H0003.text: IF an auxiliary MLP count head (global-token -> scalar count, L1 loss) is co-trained, THEN main density MAE improves, BECAUSE count supervision regularizes the shared projection toward counting-relevant features. DISPROVED IF aux variant does not beat main by >0.3 MAE.

H0011.text: IF CACViT-style scale/magnitude embeddings (exemplar box size + image magnitude codes injected into decoder input) are added IN this node, THEN MAE improves >=5%, BECAUSE normalized ViT tokens lose scale and order-of-magnitude info that density calibration needs. DISPROVED IF delta MAE in (-5%, +5%).

H0004.text: IF exemplar-conditioned cross-attention mixture-of-bases IN FSC147 beats plain cosine matching (N0002-style) under equal frozen-backbone budget, THEN MAE improves >=10% relative, BECAUSE contextual attention resolves same-class distractors that pure feature similarity confuses. DISPROVED IF MAE >= N0002's val MAE x 0.9 when compared at equal epochs.

log.reasoning: 34.26 vs N0002 42.05 = -18.5% rel (>=10% bar); faster and longer learning at equal wall-clock; quant+qual+causal concur

H0005.text: IF stride-16 attention tokens (vs stride-8 full map) are used IN the decoder, THEN MAE parity holds with >=2x step time reduction, BECAUSE counting needs global context more than fine alignment; the basis maps restore resolution. DISPROVED IF stride-16 variant loses >1.5 MAE vs stride-8 ablation.

H0006.text: IF multi-scale gated matching IN FSC147 is used, THEN it beats any single-scale variant by >=8% relative MAE, BECAUSE per-location scale gating absorbs intra-class size variance that fixed-stride matching cannot. DISPROVED IF best single-scale ablation ties or beats gated (delta <= 8%).

log.reasoning: 40.37 vs N0002 single-scale 42.05 = -4% with 6x smaller budget; below 8% bar and backbone-confounded -> weak support only

H0007.text: IF a <=12M-total frozen-EffNet model IN FSC147 reaches val MAE < 35 @ 10 epochs, THEN backbone scale is not the bottleneck at this stage, BECAUSE pretrained conv features already carry sufficient category-agnostic structure. DISPROVED IF MAE >= 35 (small-backbone hypothesis refuted for now).

log.reasoning: <=12M EffNet reached only 40.37 (>35 even @20ep, plateaued ~E14) -> small-backbone hypothesis refuted; feature scale is a bottleneck

H0008.text: IF exemplar conditioning is delivered as an implicit prompt token IN FSC147 with a frozen Swin, THEN val MAE < 40 @ 10 epochs, BECAUSE pretrained global attention can route correspondence without an explicit similarity computation. DISPROVED IF val MAE >= 40 @ 10 epochs.

log.reasoning: 32.66 << 40 (passed @E9 with 34.2); fastest-converging node; only 15% of tau_max used

H0009.text: IF implicit prompt conditioning is compared against explicit cosine matching at comparable budget, THEN implicit underperforms explicit by >=10% relative MAE, BECAUSE single-box prompts give too weak a signal to localize small instances among distractors. DISPROVED IF gap <=10% or implicit wins.

log.reasoning: implicit 32.66 BEAT comparable-budget explicit N0002 42.05 by 22%; expected ranking reversed

H0010.text: IF segmentation-style normalized-density loss replaces pure MSE IN this node, THEN optimization is more stable (lower epoch-to-epoch MAE variance) at equal MAE, BECAUSE per-pixel normalization prevents loss domination by high-count images. DISPROVED IF variance not reduced or MAE worsens >5%.

H0012.text: IF exemplar-area prompt + dual-scale gated fusion IN FSC147 (N0006 vs parent N0005), THEN val MAE <= 31.5 (>=3.5% better), BECAUSE scale info in the prompt plus finer multi-scale grid fix N0005's two bottlenecks. DISPROVED IF MAE > 32.66.

log.reasoning: 32.10 vs parent 32.66 = -1.7% only; <=31.5 bar missed; overfit onset ~E14 caps schedule gains

H0013.text: IF per-location scale gating is used at stride16/32 IN this architecture, THEN RMSE/MAE ratio drops below 3.0 at MAE parity-or-better, BECAUSE gating reallocates mass to correct scales, shrinking tail errors. DISPROVED IF ratio >= 3.0 or MAE worsens.

log.reasoning: RMSE/MAE ratio 3.18 >= 3.0; gate did not shrink high-count tail on swin substrate

H0014.text: IF the proven prompt-conditioning stack runs on a frozen DINOv2-S reg4 substrate IN FSC147, THEN val MAE <= 29.0 (>=10% better than current best 32.10), BECAUSE self-supervised category-agnostic features supply instance separability that supervised-hierarchical features lack. DISPROVED IF MAE > 29.0.

H0016.text: IF the cross-attn basis merge is trained stably on DINOv2-S IN FSC147 (lr 2.5e-4, 1 layer, K=4), THEN val MAE <= 25.5, BECAUSE contextual basis mixing adds adjacent-instance modeling on top of N0007's substrate gain once optimization noise is removed. DISPROVED IF MAE > 27.65.

H0018.text: IF count-w=1.0 (vs 0.3) is used IN multi-tap DINOv2 architectures, THEN RMSE/MAE ratio improves (drops), BECAUSE stronger L1 count penalty directly penalizes absolute count error more, reducing catastrophic outliers. DISPROVED IF RMSE/MAE ratio does not improve or worsens.

log.reasoning: RMSE/MAE 3.63x vs parent ~3.4x; no ablation with count-w=0.1 on same arch exists; unisolated confound — did not help outlier tail but did not hurt

H0019.text: IF per-token layer-gating replaces scalar gating IN multi-layer DINOv2 tap architectures, THEN val MAE further decreases by >=1.0, BECAUSE different spatial regions (small objects vs background vs crowd patches) benefit from different feature depths, and a scalar gate forces a global compromise. DISPROVED IF MAE increase or no change.

H0020.text: IF Huber loss (delta=5.0) replaces MSE in the counting head loss IN multi-tap DINOv2 architectures, THEN RMSE/MAE ratio drops below 3.0, BECAUSE Huber loss caps gradient magnitude for large errors, reducing catastrophic outlier failures without sacrificing median-case accuracy. DISPROVED IF RMSE/MAE > 3.5.
